notes.title: Patch Notes 0.1.0 - Dungeon of Grandmasters
notes.content:
1. New Content and Maps


 New Maps: Introduction of new environments? Library and Slime.
 Boss Floor Changes: Bosses can now be found every 5 floors, providing a more dynamic experience.


2. Gameplay System


 New Map Objective: Survival.
 Elite Enemies Update: Modifications to the behavior and abilities of elite enemies, offering a new level of challenge.
 Enemy Difficulty Update: The difficulty of enemies has been adjusted to improve the game's balance and provide a more challenging experience.


3. Characters and Classes


 New Classes: The addition of Cleric and Artifice offers new gameplay options, with unique abilities and strategies.
 New Abilities: New abilities have been introduced for all classes, allowing for more versatility in combat and exploration.


4. Items and Forging System


 New Chest System: A new chest system has been implemented.
 Changes in Item Forging: The time required to forge items has been reduced, making progression easier.
 Update on the Scepter and Hammer: The Scepter and Hammer items have received adjustments, improving their functionality and synergy with the new classes.


5. Economy and Trade


 Merchant and Blacksmith in All Maps Without Bosses: Now, the merchant and blacksmith can be found in any map without a boss, making trade and item upgrades more accessible.
 Update on Scrap Values: Scrap values have been adjusted to improve the game's economic balance.


6. Multiplayer and Connectivity


 Improved Multiplayer Reconnection: Player reconnection to the server has been optimized, offering a more stable experience and allowing players to resume their sessions without significant progress loss.
 Multiplayer Fixes: Various connection errors and synchronization issues have been fixed, providing a smoother, uninterrupted gameplay experience.


7. Interface and User Experience


 Interface Updates: Some user interfaces have undergone visual and functional improvements, ensuring more intuitive and clearer navigation.
 Player Collision Adjustments: Player collision has been adjusted to avoid undesirable behaviors, improving movement and interactions within the game environment.


8. Achievement System


 Steam Achievements: The game now features new achievements available on Steam, challenging players to reach significant milestones and complete specific objectives in the game.
 Floor Reached Ranking Leaderboard: A ranking system based on floors reached has been added, allowing players to compete for the best performance in their progress.


9. Other Improvements


 Logarithmic Sound Scale: A logarithmic scale has been implemented in the sound system, providing a more natural auditory experience and adjusting to environmental changes in the game.
 New Passive Skills and Skill Trees: The passive skill tree has been expanded with new options, allowing players to further customize their builds and playstyles.


10. New Bosses and Challenges


 New Boss Added: A new boss has been introduced, offering players a unique challenge and strategies to defeat it.


With these improvements and new additions, the game promises a richer, more challenging, and dynamic experience for players. We hope everyone enjoys the changes and is excited for future updates!

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.0.5 - Dungeon of Grandmasters
notes.content:
New Features and Improvements


 Sound system updated for better immersion and quality.
 Sheep damage sound updated.
 Inventory updated with general functionality and design improvements.


Bug Fixes


 Fixed an issue that occurred when minimizing or leaving the game window.
 Added information that the Steam application must be open to play.


Thank you for playing Dungeon of Grandmasters! Keep sending your feedback and stay tuned for our next updates!

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.0.4 - Dungeon of Grandmasters
notes.content:
General Changes


 Added elite enemies in mobs of level 40+.
 Magic damage removed from rings and amulets.
 All item types can now drop in any room.
 Items now feature different skills depending on the room.
 Fixed several bugs that caused the game to crash.
 Improved multiplayer functionality.
 Enhanced inventory management.


Monster Changes


 Removed scaling resistance from some monsters.
 Reduced the bleed effect applied on bosses.
 Reduced life regeneration of bosses.
 Adjusted how monster difficulty scales.
 Reduced the damage dealt by the Skeleton Master.


Skill and Character Changes


 Added a new skill for the Archer.
 The starting ability for all characters will now be the same.
 Reduced the cooldown time for Blink.
 Increased the damage of some staff spells.


Reforge and Equipment Changes


 When reforging a skill, it can no longer repeat the previous skill.
 Added a tip to indicate where to place the item for reforging.


Visual and Interface Improvements


 Introduced a unique, custom cursor for the game.
 All maps now feature stairs for easier navigation.
 Fixed multiple client-side errors.


Thank you for playing Dungeon of Grandmasters! Keep sending your feedback and stay tuned for upcoming updates!

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.0.3 - Dungeon of Grandmasters
notes.content:
Dungeon Changes

[olist]
 Fixed bugs related to sheep escapes.
 Sheep organization updated: all sheep now stay together.
 Reduced the maximum health of sheep.
 Sheep now have increased resistance to negative effects.
 Added market updates using scraps.
 Time now pauses in the SafeRoom.
 Chests are now fixed at 3 in the trap map.
[/olist]

Skill Changes

[olist]
 Fixed bugs in some abilities.
 Blink nerfed: now has a limited range and requires two clicks to use.
[/olist]

HUD Changes

[olist]
 Added new informative HUDs.
 Fixed some text issues.
 Font updated for better readability.
 It’s now possible to see which points in the skill tree are related to the active skill.
[/olist]

Player Changes

[olist]
 Map updated to improve projectile visibility.
 Fixed some bugs in multiplayer mode.
 Players no longer attack automatically when no enemies are nearby.
 Warrior’s base health increased by 50%.
 In multiplayer mode, players can now press the spacebar to spectate after dying.
[/olist]

Boss Changes

[olist]
 Increased Skeleton Master's health by 20%.
 Negative effects can now be applied to the Skeleton Master, but with reduced effectiveness.
 Reworked the Skeleton Master’s attack mechanics.
[/olist]

Skill Tree Changes

[olist]
 Spell Damage was removed and replaced with Global Damage.
 The skill tree now displays how many points are left to allocate.
[/olist]

Equipment Changes

[olist]
 Removed Spell Damage, replaced with Global Damage.
[/olist]

Monster Changes

[olist]
 Bat’s bleed chance reduced from 55% to 35%.
 Experience formula updated and bugs fixed for easy/medium difficulties.
 Skeleton Warrior functionality adjusted.
 Monster abilities now have a different color than player abilities.
[/olist]

A New Challenge Emerges: The Slime Master

From the darkest depths of the Dungeon, a new enemy has risen: the Slime Master. Towering, intimidating, and disgustingly sticky, this formidable foe will test the skills of even the bravest adventurers.

 Are you ready? This gooey adversary rewrites the rules of combat. Only the most skilled players will emerge victorious!

Be the first to defeat it and send your screenshot to our Discord or Community Hub!

Thank you for playing Dungeon of Grandmasters! Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.0.2 - Dungeon of Grandmasters
notes.content:
Updates:

[olist]
 Improvements to the multiplayer system for a more stable experience.
 Fixed client reconnection errors, ensuring faster and smoother reconnection.
 Reduced chance of the paralysis tome, balancing the gameplay.
 Overhauled the sound menu and other interfaces for more intuitive navigation.
 Redesigned the display of item characteristics, now clearer and more detailed.
 Increased the chance for players to apply effects on damage during combat.
 Added an automatically generated log when the game is closed due to errors, making troubleshooting easier.
 Fixed several critical errors that caused the game to crash.
 Arrows are now more visible, making them easier to spot during battles.
 Fixed timing issues with enemy abilities, improving gameplay balance.
 Increased the number of items available in the merchant, offering more options to players.
 Enhanced boss for a more interesting and balanced challenge.
 Updated forge system for better functionality and new upgrading possibilities.
 Added a link to the Discord server, making it easier to connect with the community.
 Arrow Skill now shoots fewer projectiles, adjusting its attack power.
[/olist]

Thank you for playing Dungeon of Grandmasters! Stay tuned for more improvements and updates!

notes.content:
Skeleton King

The First Boss, the Skeleton King, can finally be introduced.

He can be found after reaching the 10th floor of the Dungeon.

Targeting - Targets can now be decided according to the direction the mouse pointer is pointing, not just at nearby targets.

Other skills have already been modeled and will be presented when the game is available for testing.

Floor objectives

Each floor will have an objective that must be completed in order to access the next floor. These objectives can be:

Defeat all the monsters on the floor
Protect the sheep
Charge the altar

Early access

This is the news we've been looking forward to:

The game will have early access and will soon be available to you. We will reward players who participate in the community and send feedback, bugs found, suggestions and interact on Discord.

The entire Early Access build is being finalized and is expected to be finished by mid-November. The release takes around 15 days, the date set will be informed in the next post to the community.
